It had decent health and slightly fast speed. Upon death, it would spawn two [[Extra B]]s. The [[Extra B]] had less health and slower speed. ==Logbook Description== "''The Extras are positioned throughout theater productions, serving as background characters in scenes and sometimes disguising themselves as objects to help move set pieces during transitions. They are typically assigned boring tasks that the Builder doesn't want to do, though their suffering is hidden beneath tear-painted masks.''" ==Appearance== The '''Extra C''' is a dark creature which wears an orange suit with crosses on it and a white vest. On its head, it wears a white mask with golden accents and an orange hat. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *The '''Extra C''' summons in two [[Extra B]]s on death, which can only happen upon death. **The [[Hacker]] can negate its ability, preventing it from summoning [[Extra B]]s. *High DPS towers, like the [[Turret]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Warlock]] and [[Pursuit]] are recommended against this. *The '''Extra C''' is quite fast, making stalling towers like the [[Freezer]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Electroshocker]] useful against it. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Spawning |- |[[File:BreakerJump.ogg]] |When the '''Extra C''' spawns |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:BreakerDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Extra C''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ExtraCSpawn.gif|Spawning animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ExtraCWalk.gif|Walking animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ExtraCStun.gif|Stun animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseExtraC.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} TheFinalActPI4.png|'''Extra C''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} "The Final Act" Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Extra C''' in [[The Narratorium]] cutscenes. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ExtraCIconIG.png|'''Extra C''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Extra C''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Extra C''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Extra C''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Stunt Man]]|Wave 14 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Spotlight (Enemy)|Spotlight]]|hardw1 = Wave 15 (Hard)|Extra C|Wave 16|[[Dancer]] & [[Spotlight (Enemy)|Spotlight]]|Wave 18 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Dancer]]|hardw3 = Wave 18 (Hard)}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
